reviews.title: Thank you so much!
reviews.text:
Latest review:  Wow!  Just when I finally get to enjoy the daily game, I discover that I e maxed out on the levels!  At least I still have the daily games to play; but I enjoyed the weekly games. I do enjoy this game. 

Last review:
THANK YOU!  THANK YOU! THANK YOU!
Finally a daily game!  I do enjoy the monthly game, so I hope that hasn’t changed (I played it yesterday - the day the monthly game was to begin - and the daily game still wasn’t working).  But don’t think for a second that your hard work on this game isn’t appreciated. I do enjoy contributing to the suggested topics, and will continue to add my view of the world. 

My husband just got out of the hospital last week after a 16 day stay with a new cancer diagnosis - I stayed in there with him - and this game helped us weather the bad times, the tests, the consistent bad news and the boring hours of waiting.  My husband was on a different level than I was, so when we got stumped, we would trade phones, then feel like kicking ourselves for not guessing what we should’ve known!  🤣

The funny thing is, he always came up with answers I couldn’t get, and I always finished games he couldn’t get.  Isn’t that funny?  This game took us away from all the scary things in the hospital, and we will forever be grateful for that. 

My only suggestion is that white print is very difficult to see on yellow background. But maybe it’s just us. It takes a bit of effort to read the topic with white print; I always thought black print was much easier on the eyes; and my husband had it much harder, due to the pituitary tumor pressing on his optic nerve. So I had to read the questions to him.

But thank you so much for helping us through a scary part of our lives, even though you had no idea how much this game helped us.  Isn’t it funny how much of an impact one person or group of people can have on another’s life, and never even know it?  If you believe in prayer, please pray for him. We are both still fighting this uphill battle.  ❤️

reviews.title: No support or updates
reviews.text:
I’m deleting this game today. As others have reported, the daily challenge has not been working and the game has not been updated in months. I emailed support three times weeks ago and got no response. It’s not a very interesting game anyway.

Updated review 8/11/24: I tried the game again because I like trivia. It froze on level 9 on an ad for the scam Solitaire game that advertises making money. I could not move past that level.  There is no customer support so don’t bother with this game that is obviously connected to others for making money.

reviews.title: Coin ripoff
reviews.text: I have gone through 58 levels. While you get a few coins at lower levels, it quickly starts putting your EARNED coins in a piggy bank that you then have to pay $3.99 for in order to access!!  Are you kidding me??? As soon as the early ones earned are gone, so is your game. I am not paying to keep coins I earned playing.

reviews.title: I REFUSE TO PAY TO PLAY ANY GAME
reviews.text: This was fun until they asked for money. I recently reached a level in a game that was essentially the end. It was so not worth the money I had spent. I live in Vegas. If I want to waste more playing games,I have options that are more fun. It’s not as if I can’t download an app that allows me to play the same game for free. I just rotate through them, so I can always play for free.
